---
title: "Rust API"
---

The Rust API reference is generated by `rustdoc`, separately from the Python API pages generated by `quartodoc`.

The crate-level Rust API is also published on [docs.rs/reducers](https://docs.rs/reducers).

The crate also exposes a Python-independent sigma-clipping API in
`reducers::sigma_clip`. It provides a finite-only 1-D kernel and a
caller-owned reusable `Workspace` for image-stack adapters and other Rust
consumers. See the [sigma-clipping performance notes](performance/sigma-clipping.qmd)
for the implementation techniques used by the Python adapter.

For local tests, `make docs-build` to build local docs and try `rustdoc/reducers/index.html` (or Rust-only case, `make docs-rust` and check `target/doc/reducers/index.html`).
